title: becium fimbriatum var. ctenodon
intro: Becium fimbriatum var. ctenodon, commonly known as East African basil, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of East African basil include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Becium fimbriatum var. ctenodon include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
